{{Top|leg}}
'''Environmental survey devices''' were equipment used by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to monitor the changes in environment such as jungle or forest. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Farnsworth]] used these devices during his study of the jungles around the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], five of the Ithorian's environmental survey devices stopped transmitting their data to him, likely due to [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] disturbance. As a result, Farnsworth hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to go collect the data by hand.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Environmental survey devices appeared in the video game [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
